sections.churn_summary: Hold-buffer guards are live on all three focus tracks (`exit_confirm_screens=2`, `reentry_cooldown_screens=1`, `min_rebalance_notional_gbp=10.0`), and the 7-day window is operationally clean: `duplicate_day_skip=false` everywhere, `adjacent_flip_count=0`, and no active exit buffers on rules or ai_judgment (`buffered_holdings=0`, empty `exit_streak`). Primary ai_judgment shows epoch-scoped improvement versus lifetime drag (`epoch.cost_drag=0.0197`, `post_apply_trade_count=2` per `learning_track_epoch_datum`) against lifetime `cost_drag=0.2461` and `trade_count=36`, but rules control remains elevated at lifetime `cost_drag=0.3202` / `trade_count=54` with watch alerts on both rules and ai_judgment. The 7-day buffered-hold replay confirms `exit_confirm_screens=2` is marginally cheaper than 1 (`trade_count_delta_lower_minus_higher=1`, `cost_drag_delta_lower_minus_higher=0.0005` rules / `0.0006` ai_judgment). The single biggest operational learning gap is the rules-vs-primary epoch churn split: rules has `post_apply_trade_count=19` and epoch `cost_drag=0.1453` while ai_judgment has only 2 epoch trades — guards are not uniformly constraining the control book, and lifetime drag still dominates headline health.
